<thought>I need to determine how many carbonyl (C=O) groups are present in the unknown molecule. The most direct way is to look at its 13C NMR spectrum: carbonyl carbons appear in the downfield region (~190‑220 ppm). By counting the number of distinct peaks in that region I can infer the number of carbonyl groups. I will request the carbon NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
